Azam Khan Re-arrested by ED on Money Laundering Allegations

Azam Khan was sent back to jail the day after his release, with the Enforcement Directorate (ED) initiating a money laundering case against him. The ED plans to take Khan on remand for further questioning regarding alleged money laundering exceeding ₹426 crore. A PMLA court ordered his return to jail.
